gloss: one dish, one item; fine article

definitions.gloss: one dish, one item, a single dish
definitions.explanation: A single item or dish, often referring to side dishes or additional items.
An item of exceptional quality or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {一品|いっぴん}{料理|りょうり}を{注文|ちゅうもん}する。
もう{一品|いっぴん}{足|た}りない。
{今日|きょう}の{一品|いっぴん}は{何|なに}ですか。
これは{職人|しょくにん}が{作|つく}った{逸品|いっぴん}だ。
examples.english: This is a fine article made by a craftsman.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}に{一|ひと}つだけの{逸品|いっぴん}。
ご{当地|とうち}{逸品|いっぴん}を{集|あつ}めた{物産展|ぶっさんてん}。
examples.english: A fair featuring local specialty items.

notes:
{一品|いっぴん} has two distinct meanings.

SENSE 1 - ONE DISH/ITEM:
- {一品|いっぴん}{料理|りょうり}: side dish, single dish
- {一品|いっぴん}{追加|ついか}: add one dish
- あと{一品|いっぴん}: one more dish

SENSE 2 - FINE ARTICLE:
Often written as {逸品|いっぴん} for this meaning.
- {逸品|いっぴん}: masterpiece, excellent item
- ご{当地|とうち}{逸品|いっぴん}: local specialty
- {隠|かく}れた{逸品|いっぴん}: hidden gem

KANJI NOTE:
Sense 2 is often written {逸品|いっぴん} (with 逸 meaning 'excel') rather than {一品|いっぴん}.
